name: com.baziness.sdk
description: Baziness platform for Unity games: Baziness pages (sign-in, profile, rewards) in a web view, Gita coin balance, link-code sign-in from other games, install attribution, device info and player analytics. Your game server uses the Baziness server SDK.

samples.description: A MonoBehaviour that starts the SDK, shows the balance and opens the reward page.
Shows Baziness pages in gree's WebViewObject (Android, iOS, macOS editor). Import it when your project has unity-webview.
